title: Synthetic scaffolds functionalized with mesenchymal stem/stromal cells-derived extracellular matrix for bone tissue engineering: a review
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,31812-31829
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02106E, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Margarida F. Domingues, Marta S. Carvalho, Paola Sanjuan-Alberte, João C. Silva
This review explores the potential of MSC-dECM composite scaffolds for bone tissue engineering, including 3D printed, electrospun, hydrogel, and metallic scaffolds, and describes how MSC-dECM enhances their osteogenic and regenerative properties.
